text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
—...Ngh. I-I'm so sorry...
To let you see me in such an unsightly state...
choice_data_list: Haven't you been able to rest much...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...
Um... I've just been having a little trouble sleeping...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...I can't tell them. That I stayed up late
because I was pouring my feelings for Trainer into my diary...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems Still in Love couldn't get a good night's sleep...
